title: Finalmente le mille e una notte
writer: Antonio Margheriti, Luigi Russo, Dino Verde
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Femi Benussi, Barbara Marzano
plot: Sultan Almamud suddenly becomes powerless, unable to enjoy his beautiful Zumurud. The councillors then call people who can excite them by telling stories. At the end of their tales, he will finally be able to enjoy her.
